_comment: Filled in by /onboard. Read by the meta-ads-campaign-setup skill. Values wrapped in {{ }} are unfilled placeholders. The Meta access token does NOT go here; it lives in .claude/settings.local.json (git-ignored).
_ids_note: 30.10.2026: ei vielä Facebook-sivua eikä mainostiliä. Phase 4 pysähtyy, kunnes ad_account_id, page_id ja lead_form_id on täytetty.
_budget_note: campaign_daily_budget_total is the only budget authority. Test slots per round = floor(total / min_daily_budget_per_ad); each ad in the test gets total / number of ads. 15 / 5 = 3 mainosta per kierros.
_conversion_note: website: pixel_id + conversion_event are required (Purchase for a store, Lead for a website form). instant_form: lead_form_id is required, pixel_id and conversion_event may be null.
_lead_form_note: Pikalomake luodaan sivulle (Publishing tools → Instant forms): higher intent, kysymykset toimiala, liikevaihtoluokka (alle 200 k / 200–500 k / yli 500 k), nimi, puhelin, sähköposti.
